newsitem.title: USA: Abbott Labs in license deal on HIV-O.
newsitem.headline: Abbott Labs in license deal on HIV-O.

text.p: Behring Diagnostics GmBH, a unit of Hoechst AG, said Tuesday that it and privately-held Boehringer Mannheim GmBh, slated to be acquired by Roche Holding Ltd, have signed a non-exclusive worldwide licensing agreement with Abbott Laboratories Inc for patents and patent applications covering human immunodeficiency virus 1 group O (HIV-O).
Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
HIV-O, said Behring, represents a recently discovered, genetically distinct member of the HIV-1 family of viruses found in a growing number of AIDS patients since 1993.
It said that U.S., Japanese and European health authorities are now requesting that HIV-O specific antigens be included in all new standard HIV tests.

Behring added that the two companies intend to sublicense patents to other major diagnostics companies, so that state-of-the-art diagnostics tests could be developed to reliably recognize HIV-O infections.
